key_objects.name_zh: I_s(ρ) 的解析延拓与衰减
key_objects.name_en: analytic continuation and decay of I_s(rho)
key_objects.statement: Lemma 4.6 is completed: I_s extends analytically to Re(s)>-N-1, obeys |I_s(ρ)|≤c_s(1+|ρ|)^{-Re(s)}, and I_0(ρ)=N!F(0).

key_objects.name_zh: K_s Fourier 变换与 I_s 的表示
key_objects.name_en: representation of K_s Fourier transform by I_s

key_objects.name_zh: K_s Fourier 变换的解析延拓与一致有界性
key_objects.name_en: analytic continuation and uniform Fourier bound for K_s
key_objects.statement: Proposition 4.5 is completed using Theorem 3.1 and Lemma 4.6; K_s^ is uniformly bounded on the interpolation strip.

key_objects.name_zh: 曲面平均算子的平滑与 Lp-Lq 改善
key_objects.name_en: smoothing and Lp-Lq improvement for curved averages
key_objects.statement: The analytic-family interpolation proof is completed, yielding p=(d+1)/d and q=d+1 for the curved averaging operator.

key_objects.name_zh: 限制定理
key_objects.description: Studies when the Fourier transform of an L^p function can be meaningfully restricted to a lower-dimensional curved hypersurface.

key_objects.name_zh: 径向函数
径向 Lp 函数 Fourier 变换的离原点连续性
key_objects.name_en: continuity away from the origin for radial Lp Fourier transforms
key_objects.statement: If f∈L^p(R^d) is radial, then f^ is continuous for ξ≠0 whenever 1≤p<2d/(d+1).

key_objects.name_zh: 径向 Fourier 变换的 Bessel 表示
key_objects.name_en: Bessel representation of the radial Fourier transform

key_objects.name_zh: 径向连续性证明中的控制积分
key_objects.name_en: dominating integral in the radial continuity proof

key_objects.name_zh: 限制问题
L^p-L^q 限制不等式
(L^p,L^q) 限制性质
key_objects.description: The restriction property holds when (31) is valid on a dense class in L^p with a bound independent of f.

key_objects.name_zh: 非零 Gauss 曲率时限制问题的预期指数范围
key_objects.name_en: expected restriction range under nonzero Gauss curvature
key_objects.description: The expected range is 1≤p<2d/(d+1) and q≤((d-1)/(d+1))p′; in d=2 this is known, while for d≥3 the full conjectured range remains open in the text.

key_objects.name_zh: 限制定理
曲率超曲面的 q=2 限制定理
key_objects.name_en: q=2 restriction theorem for curved hypersurfaces
key_objects.statement: If M has nonzero Gauss curvature on supp dμ, then (31) holds for q=2 and p=(2d+2)/(d+3).

key_objects.name_zh: 限制算子 R
key_objects.description: R(f)=f^|_M, initially defined on compactly supported continuous functions.

key_objects.name_zh: 伴随延拓算子 R*
R 与 R* 的对偶恒等式
key_objects.name_en: duality identity for R and R*

key_objects.name_zh: R*R 的卷积表示
限制估计、伴随估计与 TT* 估计的等价性
key_objects.name_en: equivalence of restriction, adjoint, and TT* estimates
key_objects.statement: For p≥1, the L^p→L^2 restriction estimate, the L^2→L^{p′} adjoint estimate, and the L^p→L^{p′} R*R estimate are equivalent.

key_objects.name_zh: 限制定理中的解析族 S_s
key_objects.name_en: analytic family S_s in the restriction theorem
key_objects.description: Define S_s(f)=f*k_s with k_s(x)=K_s^(-x); interpolation between L^1→L∞ and L^2→L^2 at s=0 yields the critical TT* bound.

key_objects.name_zh: Theorem 5.2 推出的限制指数区域
key_objects.statement: Under nonzero Gauss curvature, (31) holds for 1≤p≤(2d+2)/(d+3) and q≤((d-1)/(d+1))p′.

key_objects.name_zh: 由曲面测度 Fourier 衰减推出的限制估计
key_objects.name_en: restriction estimate from Fourier decay of surface measure
key_objects.statement: If |dμ^(ξ)|=O(|ξ|^{-δ}), then restriction holds for p=(2δ+2)/(δ+2), q=2; with m nonzero principal curvatures this gives p=(2m+4)/(m+4).

key_objects.name_zh: 若干色散方程的应用
Schrödinger 方程
虚时间 Schrödinger 方程
Schrödinger Cauchy 初值
Schrödinger 演化算子的 Fourier 乘子
key_objects.name_en: Fourier multiplier for the Schrödinger propagator

key_objects.name_zh: Schwartz 空间上的 Schrödinger 演化
key_objects.statement: e^{itΔ} preserves S; solves the equation smoothly; equals convolution with K_t; and satisfies the L^1→L∞ dispersive estimate.

key_objects.name_zh: Schrödinger 核 K_t
Schrödinger 核的 Fourier 变换
key_objects.name_en: Fourier transform of the Schrödinger kernel

key_objects.name_zh: L² 上的 Schrödinger 演化
key_objects.statement: For each t, e^{itΔ} is unitary on L²; t↦e^{itΔ}f is L²-continuous; and the evolution solves the equation distributionally.

key_objects.name_zh: Schrödinger 方程的分布解恒等式
key_objects.name_en: distributional identity for the Schrödinger equation

key_objects.name_zh: Schrödinger Lp-Lq 色散估计
key_objects.name_en: Lp-Lq dispersive estimate for Schrödinger evolution

key_objects.name_zh: 时空整体估计的目标形式
Strichartz 估计的尺度临界指数
key_objects.name_en: scaling-critical exponent for the Strichartz estimate
key_objects.description: Scaling forces q=(2d+4)/d in the spacetime estimate (40).

key_objects.name_zh: Schrödinger Strichartz 估计
key_objects.statement: If u(x,t)=e^{itΔ}f(x) with f∈L²(R^d), then (40) holds for q=(2d+4)/d.
